parts.title: The history of glass
parts.passage_html:
A Glass was first made in Mesopotamia around 3500 BC. Early glass was opaque and used for beads.

B The invention of glassblowing in the first century BC made glass vessels cheap. Roman households used them widely.

C Modern float glass was developed by Alastair Pilkington in the 1950s, transforming window production.
